blocks.text: Buying a Home in Promontory, Chilliwack: Local Market & Neighbourhood Guide

parts.t: Promontory

is a key residential search area in the eastern Fraser Valley connected via Promontory Road, Teskey Way, Sylvan Drive, Stoneview Drive, and Thornton Road heading down to Sardis and Highway 1 Exit 119. Buyers comparing active MLS® listings in Promontory will find two-storey and basement-entry detached view houses (many with legal or potential secondary suites), hillside townhome complexes along Teskey Way and Sylvan Drive, and custom ridge-top homes. For a full breakdown of official community plans, catchment maps, and hazard overlays, read our
Promontory Neighbourhood Guide

Families looking at homes for sale in Promontory are served by Promontory Heights Elementary Community School (46200 Stoneview Drive), Vedder Middle School, Mt. Slesse Middle, and Sardis Secondary / G.W. Graham Secondary in SD33. Outdoor recreation and community amenities nearby include Jinkerson Park (off-leash dog area, sports field, tennis/pickleball courts, and playground), Mount Thom Park trailheads, and hillside viewpoint parks across Promontory. For commuters and transit riders, the area is served by BC Transit Route 54 Promontory (seven days a week connecting Sylvan Drive, Teskey Way, and Promontory Road to Vedder Road and Cottonwood Mall).

blocks.text: Zoning, Land Use Plans & Buyer Due Diligence in Promontory

parts.t: Land use and building permits in Promontory are regulated by the Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan and Development Permit Area 2 (Hillside and Upland geotechnical slope stability, retaining wall, and stormwater drainage permits). Before removing subjects on a property in Promontory, verify the title search (checking for statutory building schemes, easements, geotechnical or floodplain covenants, and freehold vs. leasehold tenure) and estimate your closing taxes with our

What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near Promontory?

How are roads, highway access, and public transit in Promontory?

Key road corridors serving Promontory include Promontory Road, Teskey Way, Sylvan Drive, Stoneview Drive, and Thornton Road heading down to Sardis and Highway 1 Exit 119. Public transit connections include BC Transit Route 54 Promontory (seven days a week connecting Sylvan Drive, Teskey Way, and Promontory Road to Vedder Road and Cottonwood Mall).
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or hazard rules apply in Promontory?

Properties in Promontory are governed by the Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan and Development Permit Area 2 (Hillside and Upland geotechnical slope stability, retaining wall, and stormwater drainage permits). Before writing an offer, check the parcel's exact zoning, Development Permit Area overlays, and floodplain elevation requirements.
Are homes in Promontory freehold or leasehold?

Most residential properties in Promontory are freehold (fee simple) or freehold strata, though select developments in the broader Chilliwack and Cultus Lake region sit on prepaid leasehold land. Always check the Title Type field on each MLS® listing and review the title search with your Realtor and lawyer.
